description: Loss-making-company engine. Value currently unprofitable companies with margin-ramp DCF, revenue multiples, Merton structural equity, the VC method, distressed waterfalls, bank residual income, and SPAC deals; every method returns a central value plus a dispersion (sigma, percentiles, long-tail). Use this when earnings-based multiples break down; for standalone probability weighting of arbitrary scenarios use calculate_expected_value, and for a single going-concern DCF use calculate_dcf. Methods: margin_ramp_dcf: revenue, growth_rate, start_margin, target_margin, ramp_years, discount_rate, years, shares_outstanding, net_debt, range_method; revenue_multiple: revenue, ev_revenue_multiple, net_debt, shares_outstanding, range_method; merton_equity: firm_value, firm_volatility, debt, risk_free, maturity, range_method; vc_method: terminal_value, target_return, investment, shares_outstanding, range_method; distressed_waterfall: enterprise_value, claims, range_method; bank_residual_income: book_value, net_income, cost_equity, growth_rate, range_method; spac_deal: trust_cash, shares_outstanding, redemption_price, range_method. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

book_value.description: Book value of equity in reporting currency.

claims.description: Ordered claims [{name, amount, priority}] for a waterfall.

cost_equity.description: Cost of equity as a decimal (0.12 = 12%).

debt.description: Debt face value (default point) for the Merton equity model.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%); pre-tax when method=viu_pre_tax.

firm_value.description: Firm/asset value for the Merton equity model.

firm_volatility.description: Asset volatility for the Merton equity model (decimal).

growth_rate.description: Periodic growth rate as a decimal (0.03 = 3%).

maturity.description: Time to expiry in years (0.5 = six months); > 0.

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

net_debt.description: Total debt minus cash and equivalents.

ramp_years.description: Years to move from start_margin to target_margin (>=1).

range_method.description: Statistic returned as the headline value; the full dispersion is always included.

start_margin.description: Opening operating margin (decimal, may be negative); margin_ramp.

target_margin.description: Normalized margin reached after ramp_years; margin_ramp.

trust_cash.description: SPAC trust cash available for redemption.

years.description: Number of projection years n; equal len(cash_flows) when both are supplied.

name: calculate_loss_making_company

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Loss-making and pre-profit company valuation
